tagline: A bigger rhythm game — bilingual UI, play modes, Bass beta, modifiers, and a profile worth sharing.

sections.title: Highlights
sections.body:
- Full **English / Russian** UI — switch anytime in Settings → System
- **Play modes hub** — Library, Endless, and Marathon
- **Original / Arcade** chart goals, **Bass (beta)**, and **Rhythm DNA**
- **36 run modifiers**, generation queue, Windows-native server
- Profile **Rhythm Rating** and **Recap** share cards

sections.title: Play modes
sections.body:
- **Library** — your songs, filters, medals, and next-track suggestions
- **Endless** — streaks from a playlist or random pool; setup chips and Same setup
- **Marathon** — fixed routes, Daily Marathon, badges, and unlock gates
- Main menu **Play** opens the hub first — not straight into the library

sections.title: Library & generation
sections.body:
- Card-style song details, richer filters, and a **genre picker** with server tips
- Generation screen: **Original** vs **Arcade**, lanes, advanced sliders, **presets**
- **Queue panel** — progress, reorder, cancel, mass BPM + notes
- Track preview: loudest **15 s** highlight (or full track) in Settings → Sound

sections.title: Bass & charts
sections.body:
- **Bass (beta)** — taps, holds, slides; same Original / Arcade goals as drums
- Chart difficulty **1–10+** with decimal stars; mods shift effective difficulty
- Health bar, defeat screen, **Last Chance**, and clearer pause / resume rewind

sections.title: Modifiers & Rhythm DNA
sections.body:
- Full-screen modifier studio — video previews, conflicts, reward multiplier
- **Rhythm DNA · Beta** mods need a `.rfd` sidecar from drum generation
- Heat, Spotlight, Combo Escalation, and more — HUD strip shows the active set
- Save **modifier presets** (10 slots) alongside generation presets

sections.title: Profile & progression
sections.body:
- Overview, Statistics, Genres, Records — plus **RR Top 10** and medals
- **165 achievements**, daily quests, and play-mode unlocks
- **Recap** — five shareable PNG cards from Profile → Export
- Shop collections, hit particles, and medal-priced cosmetics

sections.title: Settings & polish
sections.body:
- Nine settings pages with sidebar icons — Sound through Danger zone
- Keyboard nav across menus; Guitar Hero control preset
- Ambient menu washes, StatusDock toasts, and first-visit spotlight tutorials
- Help deeplinks jump straight into the right Settings page
